name: crossval
setup: X = (1:20)'; Y = 2*X + 1; predfun = @(Xtr, Ytr, Xte, Yte) mean((Xte * mldivide(Xtr, Ytr) - Yte).^2);
expr: mse = crossval(predfun, X, Y); n_folds = numel(mse); m_shape = double(size(mse, 1) == 10 && size(mse, 2) == 1);
comment: Sig: vals = crossval(predfun, X, Y[, 'kfold', K]). K-fold cross-validation. Default K=10. NOT bit-identical with MATLAB (fold splitting differs -- numkit uses contiguous blocks, MATLAB defaults to random). Shape verified.
